olivia: Heads upwe validated LangChain + Redwood gateway handshake in staging. Need a quick partner checklist for marketplace tile + joint announcement.
maria: great. can we get a one-pager with topology and auth flow? ops wants exact URLs.
aj: draft flow: LangChain runner -> signed JWT to Redwood gateway -> model pool. fallbacks to low-cost model.
kevin: sales asks about SKU & revenue share mapping. finance needs SKU by May 4 to lock billing.
olm: (typo) ignore
marketplace-bot: Reminder: create marketplace ticket when assets uploaded.
maria: partner wants embargo Apr 29 08:00 PDT. marketing needs demo video + 2-line quote by Apr 25.
aj: runner eng can record 90s demo tomorrow; will scrub logs and use synthetic data.
kevin: legal will need logo pack and usage guidelines; sam to request from partner.
maria: engineering item: swap temp API key to oauth client creds before public demo. estimate 48h.
marketplace-bot: Deploy scheduled: oauth-swap -> Apr 23 02:00 UTC. Owners: aj, maria.
aj: noted. I'll be oncall.
maria: risks: hardware quantization checks with VectorScale may delay listing. ops running tests this week.
kevin: thanks. will update release tracker and advise sales to expect May 4 earliest for marketplace listing if approvals stall.
